name: Agent Outbox
description: Lets AI assistants post messages to the user's Telegram private chat, groups and channels through a bot. Tools: send_to_telegram, list_destinations, get_usage. Hosted server; sign in via OAuth with a 6-digit code from the bot. Free 50 messages a day; Pro 10,000 messages per 30 days. Not affiliated with Telegram.
author: CloudLab Studio
